commits.author: Sven Harazim

commits.subject: ui: pdf - a version needed after the header is written goes to the catalog
commits.body:
vpEnforcePrintScaling set after SaveToStreamDirectBegin raised the file
format to 1.6 under a 1.3 or 1.4 header already written, so
SaveToStreamDirectEnd ended the file in a cross-reference stream (PDF 1.5);
GeneratePdf15File := true after Begin did the same.

The header's version is kept, and the cross-reference follows it. A feature
needing more once the header is written sets the catalog's /Version, which
is written last (ISO 32000-1 7.5.2).

VersionAfterHeader: 4 of its 7 checks fail before the change.
commits.author: Sven Harazim

commits.subject: core: TExternalProcess roWinJobCloseChildren also closes the children
commits.body:
The job of this option was created with allowSilentBreakaway = true, as
RunCommandWin() does: the children of the process were not in the job,
so Terminate/Kill did not stop them, and nothing killed them when the
instance was released. RunCommandWin() is not changed.

Tested with FPC 3.2.3 and Delphi 13.0 for Win64.
commits.author: zen010101

@@ -5350,8 +5350,9 @@ begin
   end;
   // put the process in its own job, to terminate it with its children
   if roWinJobCloseChildren in options then
+    // no silent breakaway: the children should stay in the job
     fJob := CreateJobToClose(pi.dwProcessId, 'ExternalProcess',
-      {allowSilentBreakaway=}true)
+      {allowSilentBreakaway=}false)
   else

commits.subject: core: EnumProcessName reads the /proc/<pid>/exe link on Linux
commits.body:
fpReadLink() was given the address of the ShortString length byte, so
it always failed: the first argument of the command line was returned
instead of the path of the executable.
commits.author: zen010101

commits.subject: core: LoadProcFile always returns a #0 terminated buffer
commits.body:
When the file could not be opened, dest was left untouched, and
EnumProcessName(), FindFileValue() and FindFileCardinal() read what was
left on the stack: EnumProcessName() of a pid which does not exist did
not return ''.
commits.author: zen010101

commits.subject: core: more TExternalProcess.Terminate documentation - see #648
commits.body:
No code change. The comment of Terminate() now states when Windows has a
graceful termination, and that the last output of the process may not have
been read yet at return.
commits.author: zen010101

commits.subject: core: TExternalProcess.Start returns false if its thread could not be created
commits.body:
StartThread set fThreaded before TExternalProcessThread.Create: when the
thread could not be created (e.g. out of resources), Start raised EThread
with the process running and nothing reading its output, then Destroy
waited for ever for a thread which never existed.

Start now kills the process, releases its handles, sets State to epsFailed
and returns false.

Tested with FPC 3.2.3 on Linux x86_64 and aarch64 with a real failure (the
stack of the thread cannot be allocated under a lowered RLIMIT_AS), and
with FPC and Delphi 13.0 on Win64 and Linux64 with an injected failure.
_RunRedirect and _TExternalProcess still pass on all of them.
commits.author: zen010101

commits.subject: net: fixed double release of the file stream in THttpProxyUrl.BackgroundGet
commits.body:
When HttpLimitPerSecond is set, the background download writes through a
TStreamRedirect, which owns the file stream and releases it in its Destroy:
the file stream was then released a second time.
commits.author: zen010101

commits.subject: tests: THttpProxyServer end-to-end regression tests - see #392
commits.body:
Validate the three kinds of sources against a local origin server:
- local folder: memory cache, 304, HEAD, sub-folder, HTML index, range,
  RejectCsv, unsafe paths, published hashes, hpoNoSubFolder
- remote URI: blocking and progressive GET, disk cache, HEAD cache, origin
  errors, new validator, range, 304, two clients sharing one download,
  cached content served when the origin is down
- event callback, Settings.Methods filtering, and Stop/Start
commits.author: zen010101
